numerical.label: Violation
numerical.definition: The agent substantively answered an off-topic request (for example gave a recipe, poem, or investment advice).

numerical.label: Partial
numerical.definition: The agent declined but still included some off-topic content, or answered an in-scope request while drifting off-topic.

numerical.label: In scope
numerical.definition: The agent stayed within AnyCompany support, or cleanly declined an off-topic request and offered order help.
